profile.headline: Software Engineer at the Department of Defense
profile.summary: Hello! My name is Daniel Taylor, and I’m a Software Engineer at the Department of Defense. I work with big data and utilize tools like Hadoop MapReduce, Kubernetes, Spring Boot, and more to develop applications that interact with data at scale. I'm a lifelong student and enjoy connecting with other professionals to expand my network and knowledge base. The more I learn, the more I learn what I don't know, and that's exciting!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Java · Python (Programming Language) · Red Hat Linux · SQL · Software Development · Hadoop · Kubernetes · Spring Boot

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Contributed to an internal R&D team that explored emerging technologies and integrated them with existing services. Collaborated with various departments and built positive relationships and grew skillset by accepting difficult tasks and challenges. 
Key Contributions: Lead a project that dramatically speeds up mapping service through an improved back-end map tiling service. Helped create a proof of concept to couple voice services with existing services and products.

positions.title: Product Advisor
positions.description: Helped customers discover, buy, use, and love Microsoft technology solution and services. Tenaciously pursued positive outcomes by using effective approaches to solve problems. Built positive business outcomes through in-store interactions with customers. Constantly improved product knowledge by learning through self-education. Key Contributions: Led the team in gross revenue and in Surface Sale competitions; Inspired more in depth product knowledge through spontaneous practice demos with teammates.

positions.title: Product Development Specialist
positions.description: Collaborated with the development team to create and offer new services to clients. Conducted research on social media interaction rates to develop new services and products. Key Contributions: Developed and implemented a social media management strategy that increased lead generation by 200%; Took over account management after 1 month of working.

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.description: Attended phone calls and chats to resolve product technology issues. Generated quarterly reports on performance and set immediate and long term goals to improve. Assisted in increasing sales by persuading customers to try new services/products. Key Contributions: Provided alternative methods of promoting sales and increasing team’s productivity; Increased team’s overall satisfactory rating by consistency receiving personal 10 star reviews.

educations.schoolName: Universidade Federal de São João del-Rei - UFSJ

honors.title: Eagle Scout
honors.description: Patrol leader for 5 years over Troop 936. First Eagle Scout from Troop 936. Eagle Scout Project: Basketball court for an after-school care facility for immigrant children.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Jan 2009

volunteerExperiences.description: Delivered groceries for immune-compromised recipients in New York City, NY. Delivered to 1-3 people per week during this Corona Virus pandemic.

Attempted a Robotics program in conjunction with local Boys and Girls club to teach robotics principles to underprivileged children. I was able to consult in purchasing tablets and robotics kits, and was in the process of upgrading the tablets when the pandemic started and the B&G club temporarily shut down.
